name: provision_kubernetes_ingress
description: Provisions an AWS Application Load Balancer (ALB) Ingress controller on a target EKS cluster. Call this ONLY after the deployment and service manifests have been applied and verified healthy via verify_pod_health(). DO NOT call this tool for internal-only cluster communication (use provision_cluster_ip() instead). Returns the public DNS hostname and target group ARN.

tls_cert_arn.description: Valid AWS ACM certificate ARN matching the hostname.
